name: sih-26129-interoperability-platform
description: Government Interoperability & Federated Service Delivery Platform — SIH 2026 PS 26129

scripts.start:deps: concurrently "npm start -w departments/dept-a" "npm start -w departments/dept-b" "npm start -w departments/dept-c"
scripts.start:adapters: concurrently "npm start -w adapters/dept-a" "npm start -w adapters/dept-b" "npm start -w adapters/dept-c"
scripts.start:services: concurrently "npm start -w services/identity" "npm start -w services/gateway" "npm start -w services/consent" "npm start -w services/event-bus" "npm start -w services/mdm" "npm start -w services/workflow" "npm start -w services/audit"
scripts.start:frontend: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/citizen-portal" "npm run dev -w apps/official-dashboard"
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run start:deps" "npm run start:adapters" "npm run start:services" "npm run start:frontend"
